## Invitations

During the reporting period, 2450 invitations were issued and 766 people attended. This represents a rate of 31.3 per cent. These figures provide a straightforward summary of outreach activity and attendance. The invitation total indicates the scale of contact undertaken, while the attendance figure records participation following that contact. Together, the figures support routine monitoring of the outreach service and provide a basis for reviewing how effectively invitations are encouraging attendance.

The results should be considered alongside the recorded contact activity. This will help maintain a consistent account of invitations, responses and attendance, and support the ongoing review of outreach arrangements.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 2085 invitees. A reminder was sent to 2085 invitees. Recording these contacts alongside the invitation and attendance figures provides a clear account of communication undertaken during the reporting period. The information can support service monitoring and future planning for outreach activity.

Prepared by G. Evans.
